title: Local finite freeness of the cokernel of a locally constant-rank presentation
statement: For a normed field E, scheme V, ring sheaf R identified by an invertible monoid morphism with the continuous E-function coefficients, and finite-free map f with locally constant pointwise matrix rank, there is a pro-etale cover on which the inverse image of cokernel f is finite free. No noetherian hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Example 3.1; agent rank/descent argument in original node, Local finite freeness of the cokernel of a locally constant-rank presentation

proof.text: Choose the cover and source/target decompositions from the local block normal form.
Inverse image preserves cokernels. The commuting square with the two change-of-basis isomorphisms gives an isomorphism from the cokernel of pulled-back f to that of diag(identity,zero).

The latter block map is the split epimorphism biprod.fst followed by biprod.inl. Cokernels ignore the epimorphism, and cokernel of biprod.inl is the second target summand, a finite-free module. These comparisons give precisely the required IsFree witness.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteFree_cover_cokernel_of_locallyConstant_rank (E : Type u) [NormedField E] (V : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology V) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) [MonObj R] (e : R ⟶ (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology V) (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj (continuousCoefficientRingSheaf V E)) [IsIso e] [IsMonHom e] {m n : ℕ} (f : Mod.finiteFree R m ⟶ Mod.finiteFree R n) (hr : IsLocallyConstant (fun v : V ↦ ((continuousFieldPresentationMatrix E V e f).map (fun a ↦ a v)).rank)) : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage V, ∀ i : C.I₀, Mod.IsFree ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (C.f i)).obj R) (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (C.f i)).mapMod R).obj (cokernel f))
